## Design

### 2026-10-16 – 14 Oct: 1st Session in my The miniture roller coaster project. (Modeling the station)

**5h**

14 Oct: 1st Session in my The miniture roller coaster project. (Modeling the station)

I downloaded and installed Fusion 360 and opened a new project. The roller coaster has many repeating parts, so the best strategy is to model each part using Part Design, then assemble everything in another file.

Roller coasters in RCT have 2 main parts: the station, where guests ride and exit, and the coaster itself.

In the game, the ride is 12 x 37 grids; to make a reasonably sized miniature coaster, I set each grid to 2 cm x 2 cm. This gives the final dimensions of 24 cm x 74 cm, which isn't bad at all.

First, I decided to model the station. which is this part here:
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/46e720afc8c112dd83bbf66a20eefe989487b5eb7b20a210984a32c160c22976.png)

For this, I needed dimensions, so I asked ChatGPT to give me dimensions based on some real coasters. The dimensions it gave me didn't make any sense, and i also discovered that the coaster isn't based on a real coaster like many coaster in the game, so finding any real dimensions is near impossible, meaning that i have to eyeball it or smt. so, I'll divide the station into 3 or 4 parts and model each part seperatly.

*The Station Fence*

The dimensions I chose for the fence are 0.2 mm x 0.2 mm for the post bases, and the total fence length in this image is 5 mm.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/ab7ac2625b78cf994958cb8c15f22b3227ded9372e8e5ae114d80060491de239.png)

*Station Side Planks*

I made the side planks by modeling one rectangle with dimensions of 2.5 mm x 10 mm, then rounding the edges by 0.5 mm. I then extruded it by 2 mm and used the fillet tool to round the edges again.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/61209ce0b13aa8b597378a84aeaddfc7564424ced53bea2e295b328bdcfb5f69.png)

This version of the planks has many mistakes, so I created an updated version. I removed the edge rounding and fillet from every edge except the top one and set it to 0.2 mm. I also changed the dimensions to 2.5 mm x 5 mm, so both station planks will have a total width of 10 mm, leaving another 10 mm for the train.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/b7c33a16d71b7399e82f6c0a7e318c5fb2ae2bd9c9debead122d04b43bb43295.png)

* Stations Rails (the part under the planks only)*

The next part I modeled was the black iron bars under the station planks. This is the sketch for the horizontal part.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/8b780272bfc12c19a99c9106bfa40c49e06622c526bd3ff2a04cd7b00804a687.png)

To create the full shape, I extruded the body by 3 mm and added a central support rod measuring 3 mm x 3 mm x 20 mm. Next, I'll add a side support
.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/fb32563c67980dc51224fb17a5dcad7a55682ca8be07fffc9e2608d22a9b8a70.png)

I spent some time changing the model a bit so it matches the one in the game. Now, the side supports.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/fe2957cb1c3fd61ba0da1d328415677d3d92fde6ecef484d7f2babb8cdfb2c85.png)

These are the dimensions for the side support,
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/a1bf9259b5349549dc92e422a87dfa2a8161fac4326f8e79ff04ca5f6653ab7c.png)

These are the dimensions for the side support.

I extruded the side supports by 1 mm and added a 1 mm chamfer to two sides. This is the final shape of the rails under the side planks. Now, the next part is the rails in the middle.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/6470b446b858c342db97285763a45b773e43a41d422a04f22ab68bba55776420.png)

I tried working on the middle, but I have no idea what those parts are, and my search led me nowhere. So, I decided to assemble the station for now. Then, I'll deal with the middle part.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/1fbbaac273ba83a76dd8aaf418a59e9bd700a858e11a00a2629f558321c95e66.png)

*Station Initial Assembly*

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/si7oUujLPcQATsL6MYHnfHND9xDBNL6K/531da9bd626242c60dbd365e4fc7a5be86dfc5daa39c8c5138c833956d1dfc70.png)

This is the station after assembly. A few edits are needed: the rails under the planks need to be shorter by 2 to 3 mm, and the fence dimensions were completely wrong, so it has to be made again from scratch.

tl;dr, I started modeling the Station, I finished the sides of the station, but It needs some edits. Also the Station rails are yet to be modeled.

Total Time Spent: 5h
